title: Article 41 — Right to work, to education and to public assistance in certain cases

content.overview: Article 41 directs the State, within the limits of its economic capacity and development, to make effective provision for securing the right to work, to education and to public assistance in cases of unemployment, old age, sickness and disablement, and in other cases of undeserved want.
content.glance: Within economic capacity: right to work, education, and public assistance (unemployment, old age, sickness, disablement, undeserved want).
content.study:
Article 41 is expressly conditioned on the limits of the State’s economic capacity and development. It has informed employment guarantee, education, and social security legislation and has been read with Article 21 in expanding socio-economic dimensions of life and livelihood.

Examination: economic capacity limit; work; education; public assistance heads.
